text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—The time has come once again this year.
The dream stage for every racing fan:
the Grand Prix, Arima Kinen!—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—In this golden age of rivaling legends,
what kind of dreams will be born?!
Please wait just a moment longer for post time—”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, to think that everyone
would actually come by to see me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As a fellow entertainer, I deeply respect your journey, Senpai. On a grand stage like today, of course I'd want to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Every single one of your races was so explosive,
they shook the entire era, Senpai.
I truly believe today will be no different!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Fuji and Bubble were
a tremendous help to me when I was
aiming for the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Being able to see how you ran up close led me to where I am today.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. If so, what kind of words do you have for me,
who trained alongside you?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?
I'll fulfill my promise as my way of saying thanks.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely, McQueen.
Today, I'll show you a new form of your running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I have high expectations for you.
Please run safely through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Lady Stego.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo, little lady.
We've known each other for quite a while now, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Having documented Lady Stay Gold's hoofprints for so long,
I am certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
May today's Arima Kinen...
become truly unforgettable for Lord SteGo.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please... go and enjoy yourself.
I want to burn the sight of you having more fun than anyone into my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...I'll make sure you never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, those who came to cheer departed,
leaving just Stay Gold and myself alone in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...It was a long time ago, but do you remember?
The lucky item that
Fukukitaru divined for you."
choice_data_list: ...It was something like a compass, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly that.
It just occurred to me now, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, they're definitely talking about you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that right? Throughout this journey,
you've always shown me the guiding principles
for choosing my path.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It was thanks to that strategy...
that I was able to make it all the way
to this Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
To me, you are my one and only compass.
——That's what you are to me.
choice_data_list: ...One of a kind... and second to none...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Let us bear witness together, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What awaits at the end we discovered together, that is.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Guess I'll be on my way, then."
choice_data_list: Enjoy today. Have a wonderful Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —To you as well. Have a wonderful Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you! Stego-san!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's been a while since everyone's been together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!
I have been waiting for this moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today, Nakayama is the greatest power spot in the world! My fortune is at an ultra-ultra-ultra-ultra peak!! I shall claim victory and seize divine destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: All right, then let's test our luck in this decisive battle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Following Lord SteGo's example,
I fully intend to enjoy myself
to the utmost today as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"And I intend to deliver it to the Mejiro family.
...The glory of the Grand Prix."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I have someone I wish to bestow that glory upon as well.
...I can't simply yield it to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to you that I can run in today's race.
So, with no regrets—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The view from the front is mine.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you think you've got what it takes.
...You're staying with me until the very end today, too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (............Thank you, everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(If it weren't for all of you, I'm sure
I never would have made it to this race either—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gollllld!!
Prove you're the strongest here todayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Stego's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Do your beeeest!!
SteGo, you're the star of the show todayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! As expected of Stego-san...! Even among this lineup, her presence stands out—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Today's Arima Kinen.
Without a doubt, it will be a fierce battle that goes down in racing history.
That is why I cannot afford to lose."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Defeating everyone, including SteGo-senpai who leads the era.
Can you display your pride as a Tiara Umamusume, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course...!
I won't lose to Stego-san or Air Groove-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Stego-senpai truly has that undeniable aura, yes she does!
Truly the strongest horse girl in the nation...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, seriously...
...She leaves zero openings, it's brutal.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Then again, that's just how it should be.
Today, right here, I will surpass Stego-san...
and prove that I am the King!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! El will defeat SteGo-senpai too!
Seize the title of strongest in the nation!
And spread my wings to the world!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, if I could pull one over on her... it'd probably give me a huge confidence boost for the future, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"With all that attention directed at her, yet she carries herself so majestically...!
I need to follow Stego-san's example—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, Digital-chan...!?
Wh-What's wrong?
You look completely spaced out...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah, th-there's just too much information...
My brain can't finish processing it all—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ――Hah! N-No no no! Now's not the time to short-circuit!! I gotta burn this miraculous race into my memory~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A miraculous race... That really is true, isn't it?
So many incredible competitors, all gathered together...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I want to win today...! For the sake of everyone who believes in me!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...The path to the summit.
So you are the one standing in my way after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: With absolute focus and all my might, I will defeat you today, Stego-san. ...Prepare yourself.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wawa... Stego-san and everyone else
are glaring so intensely...! But――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose today, either...!
In order to stay...
Opera O-san's rival...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Clad in sparkle like shining stars...
it's as if I'm standing in the middle of space――)
――Stego!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, Pokke, huh.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...You're always acting so cheerful.
Well, that ends today."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take it from you.
That spot at the 'top.'"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I'll prove it before everyone here.
That I'm the strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry Pokke, no can do.
Seeing as right now—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm having the time of my life.
This won't be stopping anytime soon, you know.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
That's just how Ste-go-san ought to be!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Opera O...—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: On any stage, when you laugh and proclaim "I myself am destiny," even a deus ex machina would weep.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yet this Century's End Overlord is different!!
No matter the stage, I am the Overlord!
The center of this world, and the most beautiful! Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"On this majestic stage of the Arima Kinen,
shall we not play our final movement?!
With the curtain closing upon my victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Not a chance.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what role you play,
but today's victory is another matter. The ending will be written by me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wrapping it up with a victory, huh.
—No, I'm the one who will win!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Because the Arima Kinen... is the stage where the most dreams in Japan come together!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Stego-san, let's race!!
Today, I'm going to win and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That I'm the Umamusume with the biggest dream in Japan... No, the best in Japan!
I'll prove it to Stego-san and to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...That's nice—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (If I could give all of you a dream, that would be――)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds totally, utterly thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's begin.
Let's enjoy ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: An Arima Kinen that belongs to us alone, that nobody knows.
